title: permission: four texts still say allowRestore / allowPurge "return with M2" after #30237 PR 4 corrected the tombstones (migration entry 18, conversion entry 18, ui permission slice, metadata plugin comment)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pXkgNXVpCn2GZDjyy

Filing gate: ③ stale prose. #30237 PR 4 (PR #31438) corrects the `allowRestore` / `allowPurge` tombstone texts under the maintainer's consent (card #30237 comment 6720657486): restore and purge exist (ADR-0148), and their grants are `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` / `manageRecycleBin`. Four more texts outside that consent still say the keys "return with M2". The card thread listed them in its round-1 handback.
Reach:
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/18/permission-allow-restore-purge-removed.ts`: its `summary`, which `os migrate meta` prints to authors upgrading old metadata.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.permission-restore-purge-bits-retired.ts`, plus its generated row in `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/permission-slice.ts`: code comments.
- `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` (~:1207): a code comment.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `"M2" allowRestore` found no card for these texts. The nearest are #30237 and #30847 (skills docs).
Reader: the spec lane (`domain:spec`), after PR #31438 merges. The ui comment can ride along or go to the ui lane.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 旧权限键 `allowRestore` / `allowPurge` 的墓碑文字已在 PR #31438 中改成「操作已存在，请改用 `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` / `manageRecycleBin`」。另有四处仍写「随 M2 回归」，其中第 18 号转换条目的摘要会由 `os migrate meta` 打印给作者看。
- **影响面：** 升级旧元数据的作者会读到错误指引；另外两处只是代码注释。
- **需要您做的：** 第 18 号迁移和转换条目是历史版本记录。spec 车道会先判断这类条目能不能改文字，如果需要您同意，会经评估线程问您。

## Task

- [ ] Decide whether a released migration or conversion entry's prose may be reworded. Look for an immutability pin or a precedent. If it may, point the `summary` and the semantic entry at `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` / `manageRecycleBin` (ADR-0148) and regenerate the registry. If it may not, record why on this card.
- [ ] Fix the two code comments (metadata `plugin.ts`, ui `permission-slice.ts`).
- [ ] Prose only. No accept-set, conversion behaviour or tombstone change.
